title: OpenAI releases 722 AI-generated mathematics manuscripts.
summary: 372 research families, with many Lean proofs. Verification is ongoing; some results remain unformalized and may contain errors.

title: ChatGPT dots bring ongoing work to AI agents.
summary: OpenAI introduces dots: agents with cloud computers and connected apps, designed to keep working on tasks over time.

title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 takes on everyday knowledge work.
summary: Anthropic introduces a Sonnet update aimed at coding, documents, and well-scoped tasks.

title: Jev approaches AI decisions through types and probabilities.
summary: TypeSafe introduces Jev and System One models for classification, routing, and scoring with calibrated probabilities.

title: Grok Bot joins the AI teammate landscape.
summary: xAI introduces always-on teammates that work with cloud computers and connected applications.

title: Falcon-Emirati brings local language and culture into AI.
summary: TII introduces a model focused on Emirati Arabic, cultural context, and everyday expressions.

title: Reflection introduces Beam for coding and agentic work.
summary: An early-access model preview focused on coding, reasoning, and agents. Public weights are planned later this month.

title: Meta brings Muse into small-business workflows.
summary: Meta outlines how its personal agent can help with everyday business tasks and connected applications.

title: Google rounds up its latest AI launches and updates.
summary: Catch up on Google’s September AI announcements across products and research.

title: NVIDIA explores open models for telecom AI.
summary: A look at how telecom operators use open models in their AI infrastructure.

title: Microsoft introduces Copilot Home, Code, and Autopilot.
summary: Microsoft outlines new ways to organize work, develop software, and delegate tasks in Copilot.

title: MIT’s InstructMesh helps repair AI-generated 3D models.
summary: A research tool lets users adjust generated 3D designs before fabrication.
